context: Write a decision record grounded in official GitHub documentation and live repository inventory. Enumerate every repository workflow and hosted setting that must change, the exact operator sequence, negative controls, rollback limits, and migration downtime. Include Pages/CNAME, redirects, Actions secrets/variables, rulesets, apps, webhooks, packages, environments, badges, clones, and external integrations. Compare one final merge_group full validation per queued group with the custom reduced-refresh residual risk.
description: Determine whether transferring BenchBox from a user account to a free organization and adopting GitHub's native merge queue is preferable to permanent custom refresh logic. This is an assessment and migration handoff only: do not transfer the repository, change settings, create an organization, or enable a queue. Verify current GitHub availability, squash compatibility, merge_group behavior, required check topology, auto-merge/Codex workflow effects, and all transfer side effects.

anti_patterns.dont: Call repository transfer a one-afternoon zero-risk operation
anti_patterns.instead: inventory and gate each migration surface
anti_patterns.why: Pages, secrets, URLs, integrations, and permissions can change

anti_patterns.dont: Claim merge queue eliminates final CI
anti_patterns.instead: compare where and how often full integration runs
anti_patterns.why: it validates temporary merge groups against the latest base

anti_patterns.dont: Combine native queue and a privileged custom steward
anti_patterns.instead: keep the steward rejected and select one mechanism

anti_patterns.dont: Enable merge queue before merge_group workflows report every required context
anti_patterns.instead: rehearse and verify all contexts first
anti_patterns.why: the queue will wait or fail on missing checks

preserves.behavior: Every required context must support merge_group before queue activation
No repository transfer or hosted setting mutation occurs in this TODO

develop-post-merge remains a separate safety net
